int_name: RISING SUN AVE & E ROOSEVELT BLVD

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated signals, creating a high-exposure environment. Wide roadway widths and visual obstructions from large vehicles further compromise pedestrian safety at this location.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this large intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large vehicles in the foreground and parked cars along the curb block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground and along the far curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals and improve safety at the signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross by moving them past the line of parked cars.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane arterial road with faded pavement markings and a marked crosswalk on only one side of the intersection. A 'No Crossing' sign on the right side indicates a lack of pedestrian connectivity across all legs, and the overall design prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Faded pavement markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk and lane lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the intersection on the left and center roadway

hazards.name: Prohibited crossing
hazards.description: A 'No Crossing' sign restricts pedestrian movement, likely forcing longer detours or unsafe mid-block crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the Dunkin' entrance
